2e71903f-3b53-442e-aa9f-867c9045ab97.quote: Willy's Steel did the support job properly. Twenty wards to Phase's nine, the most mitigation on our team, and one death, which came in our only lost fight. Keep all of that. The next layer is aiming the vision at the team's weak spot: before each Fangtooth spawn, Willy puts a ward on the pit approach so Goldilocks makes the contest-or-trade call with eyes on it instead of a guess.

2e71903f-3b53-442e-aa9f-867c9045ab97.quote: Goldilocks played a clean jungle game: no deaths, the team's heaviest objective damage, and Rampage killed twice in fights we won, once after Rampage took Murdock down. That punish is the standard: when Rampage dives a carry, Wukong follows him in and finishes him. The hole was the first Fangtooth going free with all five of us alive, so Goldilocks owns that timer and starts the call before it spawns.

82206512-cdab-4400-883b-748030bf8012.quote: A proper win built on Belica's damage and Wukong's objective work. We took first blood and the first Fangtooth, then let the middle slip: they took the next two Fangtooths, and their Mini Prime fell with all five of us alive. After that Mini Prime they never took another major objective. Orb Prime went straight into inhibitors and the core, and we finished ten towers to their one. The finish was clean; the middle was sloppy as hell.
